title: AI benchmarks miss 90% of the work people actually do
summary: Mercor mapped how US working hours are spent against the benchmarks AI labs use to measure their models, and found that 90% of working hours go to tasks those tests don't cover well.

title: Waymo heads to Toronto
summary: Waymo, the self-driving taxi company owned by Google's parent Alphabet, announced Toronto as a new city for its driverless cars.

summary: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a new AI image model, and it is already available in Hugging Face's Diffusers library for anyone to run.

title: Tiny magnetic robots deliver medicine inside a beating heart
summary: Johns Hopkins researchers built wireless millirobots, steered by magnets from outside the body, that can carry medicine to the heart while it keeps beating.

title: Beam: a 501-billion-parameter open model you can run yourself
